description: This file contains shell script code related to Wi-Fi device detection, configuration, and management for the mac80211 driver in OpenWrt.

methods.name: check_mac80211_device
methods.description: Checks if a given device matches specific criteria such as phy path or MAC address.

methods.name: __get_band_defaults
methods.description: Retrieves default band parameters for a given Wi-Fi physical interface.

methods.name: get_band_defaults
methods.description: Processes raw band data to determine default mode, channel, and HT mode.

methods.name: check_devidx
methods.description: Checks and updates device index based on radio number.

methods.name: check_board_phy
methods.description: Associates a physical interface with a board configuration.

methods.name: detect_mac80211
methods.description: Main function that detects available mac80211 Wi-Fi devices and configures them accordingly.
